ANURADHIKA V  
Global Custody & Asset Servicing Specialist 
anuradhikav16@gmail.com | +91-8618424765 | India  
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  
  
 
Results-driven Custody Banking professional with 7+ years of progressive experience in Global Custody Operations, Income 
Processing, Reconciliation, and Regulatory Compliance. Proven track record at Northern Trust in driving 20% STP efficiency 
gains, leading cross-border process migrations, and delivering zero-defect outcomes during high-volume dividend cycles. 
Deep expertise in CASS regulatory frameworks, corporate actions (mandatory & voluntary), SWIFT/CREST/Euroclear 
settlements, and capital markets trade life cycle. Recognized as an Exceptional Performer (2020 & 2021) with a history of 
automation-led process transformation.  
CORE COMPETENCIES  
  
 
▪ Asset Servicing & Custody: Global Custody Operations · Income Processing · Corporate Actions (Mandatory & 
Voluntary)  
▪ Risk & Compliance: CASS Regulation · FCA Guidelines · Internal Audit & Controls · Risk Mitigation  
▪ Settlements & Payments: SWIFT · CREST · Euroclear · BACS · CHAPS · WIRE · TLM  
▪ Reconciliation: Exception Management · Reconciliation Centre of Excellence · Aged Breaks Resolution  
▪ Reporting & Analysis: MIS Reporting · Root Cause Analysis · BOD/EOD Sign-offs · SLA Management  
▪ Efficiency & Automation: STP Optimization · Process Migration · Automation Initiatives · SOP Development  
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE  
  
 
Technical Coordinator | Northern Trust Services Pvt. Ltd.  Nov 2023 – June 2026  
▪ Oversee end-to-end daily asset servicing operations for global custody clients, ensuring 100% adherence to service level 
agreements and international regulatory standards.  
▪ Serve as primary escalation point of contact, providing timely guidance and resolution support across operations teams.  
▪ Led the SWIFT straight-through processing (STP) project, delivering a 20% improvement in STP efficiency and reducing 
manual intervention touch-points.  
▪ Authored, reviewed, and maintained Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's), proactively identifying procedural gaps and 
embedding robust risk controls.  
▪ Facilitated internal audits, controls testing, and compliance checks aligned with CASS and FCA regulatory frameworks.  
▪ Liaised with client representatives and middle-office teams to resolve complex queries, ensuring seamless 
communication and relationship management.  
▪ Performed control design and operating effectiveness testing across Global Custody and Asset Servicing processes, 
assessing controls against CASS/FCA requirements and internal policies, identifying gaps and supporting 
remediation to strengthen the overall control environment  
▪ Delivered structured market awareness sessions to supervisors and focused groups, promoting knowledge sharing and 
process alignment across the business.  
▪ Monitored CASS/FCA regulatory developments and assessed their impact on Global Custody and Asset Servicing 
processes, supporting updates to controls, procedures and compliance requirements.  
▪ Championed process improvement initiatives, reducing operational error rates and supporting automation adoption 
across custody workflows.  
Senior Financial Analyst | Northern Trust Services Pvt. Ltd.  Oct 2020 – Oct 2023  
▪ Managed day-to-day supervisory operations, ensuring on-time task completion and consistent adherence to SLAs across 
all assigned custody processes.  
▪ Conducted quality assurance reviews and second-level validations, materially reducing internal and external error rates 
across critical income and reconciliation workflows.  
▪ Contributed to multiple process testing and improvement initiatives, driving a 15% increase in team-wide operational 
efficiency.  
▪ Built and maintained strong working relationships with governance teams, stakeholders, and business partners,  
aligning operational goals with wider organizational strategy.  
▪ Provided BOD and EOD sign-offs to senior leadership, ensuring timely, accurate reporting and end-to-end process 
accountability.  
Financial Analyst | Northern Trust Services Pvt. Ltd.  Sep 2018 – Sep 2020  
▪ Processed mandatory corporate action events — including dividends, interest payments, and redemption's — for CREST 
and Euroclear markets, ensuring accurate and timely settlement.  
▪ Reviewed and validated SWIFT messages, managing fund movements via BACS, CHAPS, WIRE, and TLM payment 
systems.  
▪ Performed reconciliation and payment validation across high-volume cycles, maintaining accuracy benchmarks and 
resolving account discrepancies with depositories.  
▪ Identified and implemented process improvement initiatives that reduced manual errors and enhanced operational 
throughput.  
▪ Played a pivotal role in the successful migration of the Euroclear Income process to Pune and led reconciliation 
migration to the Reconciliation Centre of Excellence.  
  
  
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS  
  
 
▪ Led the SWIFT project that significantly improved straight-through processing rates, reducing manual intervention and 
settlement errors - 20% STP Efficiency Gain  
▪ Contributed to process improvement initiatives as Senior Financial Analyst, measurably increasing team-wide 
operational productivity - 15% Efficiency Improvement  
▪ Recognized for outstanding accuracy and delivery consistency during high-volume income processing cycles - 
Exceptional Performer Award (2020 & 2021)  
▪ Spearheaded the Euroclear Income process migration to Pune and the reconciliation migration to the Centre of 
Excellence - Process Migration Leadership  
▪ Acknowledged by the Process Optimization Team for automation initiatives that reduced manual errors and improved 
operational controls - Automation Recognition
